en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a serene park lake with people rowing small boats. Along the far shore is a tree‑lined promenade with benches, a pavilion or kiosk, and a classical-looking lakeside building visible through the trees. In the foreground there is a grassy slope with benches and a large ornamental planter on a pedestal overlooking the water. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Hilmteich."
